summary.text: Dave Syverson is the Illinois State Senator for the 35th District; the legislature's member page gives Syverson's term as "1993 - Present".

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Syverson was born in Chicago, raised and educated in Rockford, and lives in Boone County.
Syverson works as an independent financial and benefits broker in Rockford.
